description: Password sign-in decision: valid credentials vs unknown email vs wrong password vs deactivated account.

cases.log: Sign-in succeeded for account {UserId}.; audit row SignedIn (actor = the user, object = User, details { method: "password" }).
preconditions: Active account organizer@example.com exists with role Meeting Organizer holding capabilities [MeetingCreator].
Password hasher verifies the stored hash for the supplied password.
cases.return: SignInResult Success with the user, capabilities [MeetingCreator], an access token, a refresh token (stored for the user) and access-token expiry = now + configured lifetime.

cases.log: Sign-in rejected: invalid credentials.; no audit row (an unknown email is not recorded).
cases.return: SignInResult Failure(InvalidCredentials) (MSG01); the password is still verified against a dummy hash so timing does not reveal the missing account.

cases.log: Sign-in rejected: invalid credentials.; audit row SignInFailed (actor = the user, details { method: "password", reason: "invalid_password" }).
Sign-in rejected: account {UserId} is deactivated.; audit row SignInFailed (details { method: "password", reason: "account_deactivated" }).
preconditions: Account former@example.com exists and is deactivated.

cases.log: Sign-in rejected: invalid credentials.; audit row SignInFailed with reason "invalid_password".
preconditions: Account former@example.com exists and is deactivated.
cases.return: SignInResult Failure(InvalidCredentials) (MSG01): the password is checked before the account status, so the caller cannot learn the account is deactivated.

preconditions: No repository access is needed for a blank email.
cases.return: SignInResult Failure(InvalidCredentials) (MSG01); the account store is not read and nothing is recorded.

preconditions: No repository access is needed for a blank password.
cases.return: SignInResult Failure(InvalidCredentials) (MSG01); the account store is not read and nothing is recorded.

cases.log: Sign-in succeeded for account {UserId}.; audit row SignedIn (method "password").
cases.return: SignInResult Success: the email is trimmed before the lookup, so the account is found.

cases.log: Sign-in succeeded for account {UserId}.; audit row SignedIn (method "password").
preconditions: Active account exists whose role holds no capabilities (BR-04).
cases.return: SignInResult Success with an empty capability list and a token pair; a role without capabilities is not refused.

precondition: Seeded users exist (active, deactivated); password hasher configured.
